item.subject: science
item.stem: Aarav blows exhaled air through lime water in a test tube, and his teacher Meera passes inhaled (fresh) air through lime water in a second test tube. Only the lime water with exhaled air turns milky. What should Aarav correctly conclude from this experiment?

options.A: Exhaled air contains more carbon dioxide than inhaled air, but it still contains some oxygen.
options.B: Lime water turning milky shows that exhaled air contains oxygen.
options.C: Inhaled air contains more carbon dioxide than exhaled air.
options.D: Exhaled air contains no oxygen at all.
